scope: Native-owner engineering experiment on a declared finite Gaussian decision-time MDP; not a trained end-to-end SNN or natural-task efficacy claim
transition: Use exported survival-weighted Gaussian-bin rows exactly; missing mass kills with zero recovery; no second hazard multiplication
same_information: All arms receive identical current grid state, remaining time, complete registered dynamics, resource profile and allowed actions; no future random draws
constant_threshold_selection: Tune a constant lower-abstain/upper-stop pair on the exact registered MDP. Candidate grids are every fifth state plus payoff_cost and outside-grid sentinels (state_min-1 for lower,state_max+1 for upper), with lower<=payoff_cost<=upper. Maximize expected utility averaged across the seven fixed starts; ties choose higher lower then lower upper. No sampled endpoint inspection.
paired_noise: Counter-based SHA256(seed,start,step), first 53 bits mapped to open unit interval; shared across arms at the same logical step
actual_stopping: STOP/ABSTAIN commits a terminal host event and performs no later model tick or task transition. Zero-action gradient work is not called stopping.
native_owner: Original AgentdNeuronOwner + NeuronRuntime + SparseJournal + FileAnchorWitnessStore, original source bytes and exact feature receipts
host_permit: Research-only local finite-MDP observation and outcome files inside the registered run directory; no external service, daemon activation, model promotion or production effect
calibration: Exhaustive finite encoder-domain validity only; prediction=registered encoded drive. No semantic success confidence or production calibration claimed.
readout_profile: Frozen versioned value/continuation/stop/action table, separately bound to selected numeric and runtime tuple; native checkpoint fields retain their original meanings
engineering_gates: Exact event retry has zero new native transitions
Cold recovery preserves checkpoint and action
Truncated or changed event record is rejected
Report actual stop/continue/abstain and all-baseline rates
Exact registered 168-episode roster and 56 paired contexts; complete flag alone is insufficient
Every arm applies its readout at least once; all-native-fallback fails the execution gate
Candidate stop and continue actions must both execute; DP parity alone cannot pass an unexercised candidate
Free-boundary versus same-information exact-DP parity within declared numerical tolerance
scientific_claim_rule: Sampled utility and cost comparisons descriptive only; neutral/negative results retained. Integration parity is not unique Hepta or free-boundary advantage.
cost_accounting: Charge actual owner ticks, native journal replay, independent event-ledger validation, readout evaluation, Bellman multiply-adds, threshold search, model-table generation, RPC CPU/wall, allocations, journal/witness/event bytes, failed requests and recovery; task running fee is separate from measured physical time
cold_recovery: Close process and resume at first continuation for every episode with an eligible prefix; verification replay costs counted separately
source_freeze: Root registers complete protocol/source/build/model identities before the first scientific trajectory; engineering smoke tests use distinct small fixtures
selected_parameter_updates: None during a run; future learned replacement uses compatible next-snapshot bundle
tie_rule: At horizon0 stop iff immediate payoff>0 else abstain. Positive horizons abstain iff max(stop,continue)<=0, stop on positive stop>=continue tie, else continue. Fixed pair handles deadline first, lower abstain second, upper stop third.
independent_replay: After trajectories seal, independently reconstruct every reward and transition, reopen every complete original journal/witness/event ledger, verify exact retry and unchanged bytes; verification costs recorded separately.
